entities.summary: Louis Jean-Baptiste Lépine was a French lawyer, politician and administrator who was Governor General of Algeria from 1897 to 1898 and twice Prefect of Police with the Paris Police Prefecture from 1893 to 1897 and again from 1899 to 1913.
